about: Hand-written synthetic grounding set (P1-D, 2026-10-22). Each pair: a source text, a claimed memory, and whether the source supports it. `type` names the trap. Used now to measure how well the LLM judge detects unsupported memories (so its unsupported-rate numbers can be trusted), and in P3 as the test set for the grounder. Not yet spot-checked by the owner.
